   190  static int is_bad_linker_command(
   191      unsigned cmd, unsigned cmdsize,
   192      unsigned headway, unsigned lc_seg, unsigned szAddr)
   193  {
   194      cmd &= ~LC_REQ_DYLD;
   195     return !cmd  // there is no LC_ cmd 0
   196     || sizeof(lc_cmd_size) <= cmd  // beyond table of known sizes
   197     || !lc_cmd_size[cmd]  // obsolete, or proper size not known to us
   198     || !cmdsize || ((-1+ szAddr) & cmdsize)  // size not aligned
   199     || headway < cmdsize  // not within header area
   200     || (lc_seg == cmd  // lc_seg must have following lc_sections
   201         && (cmdsize - lc_seg_info[szAddr>>3].segcmdsize) %
   202                       lc_seg_info[szAddr>>3].seccmdsize)
   203     || (0 < lc_cmd_size[cmd] &&  lc_cmd_size[cmd] != (int)cmdsize)  // not known size
   204     || (0 > lc_cmd_size[cmd] && -lc_cmd_size[cmd]  > (int)cmdsize)  // below minimum size
   205     ;
   206  }
